entry.title: New: Bill 135 (2023) (Maui) — Agenda Ready
entry.content:
"A BILL FOR AN ORDINANCE AMENDING THE FISCAL YEAR 2024 BUDGET FOR THE COUNTY OF MAUI, APPENDIX A , PART I, DEPARTMENT OF POLICE" The purpose of this bill is to add a new grant under the Department of Police entitled “Hawaii Medical Service Association (HMSA)” in the amount of $11,000.

View on the council site
